title: 20 Web Styles · Original + HTML + Prompts + Design Anatomy
original_prompt_status: Reverse-engineered prompts from original image; historical prompt text unavailable

items.name: Sonora
items.description: 静奢音响 · 自然材质
items.hero: 左文右产品的连续摄影场景；柔和墙面阴影把文案自然过渡到音响主体。
items.layout: 极简横向导航 → 全幅产品 Hero → 四列价值故事 → 材质与声学 → 简约页脚
items.type: 轻字重几何无衬线；大标题疏朗、负字距轻微，辅助字使用大字距小型大写。
items.assets: 音箱、木纹、编织织物、建筑阴影和家居场景属于图像素材。
items.code: 标题、CTA、四列卡片、材质选项、声学控件、导航和收藏均为可编辑 HTML。
items.reuse: 家居、香氛、音响、家具、护肤品牌；以摄影质感代替动效堆砌。
items.pitfall: 避免在 Hero 左侧叠加纯色硬分栏；避免重复的装饰性小字和过度阴影。
items.prompt: Design a premium Scandinavian home-audio brand landing page named SONORA, elegant quiet luxury. A wide edge-to-edge sunlit limestone interior with a sophisticated cream fabric and walnut oval wireless speaker on a travertine shelf. Left-aligned airy headline “Sound for a brighter home”, restrained black rounded CTA, minimal navigation with generous letter spacing. Below: four editorial cards showing speaker in a home, exploded driver engineering, tactile fabric and wood close-up, and a quiet living room vignette. Warm beige, stone, walnut, soft botanical shadows, meticulous product photography, editorial Swiss spacing, realistic materials. Desktop full-page website art direction, clean grid and legible hierarchy.

items.name: Wilderly
items.description: 生活方式杂志 · 意大利海岸
items.hero: 左侧大型衬线封面标题叠在海岸摄影上，右侧是独立的 FEATURED STORY 编辑侧栏。
items.layout: 大字标杂志导航 → 摄影主封面 + 右侧精选故事 → 一栏导语 + 四列专题 → 极细页脚
items.type: 高反差衬线展示字体 + 中性正文衬线；标题占据版心而不是用粗体按钮抢眼。
items.assets: 海岸、人物、农舍静物、远足和海湾摄影作为整张干净图片。
items.code: 所有标题、分类、时长、页码、轮播箭头及文章入口必须用代码制作。
items.reuse: 旅行媒体、摄影刊物、文化杂志、精品酒店内容站；摄影 + 字体即主要设计资源。
items.pitfall: 避免图片和文字硬分隔，以及让卡片标题太小、侧栏过分拥挤。
items.prompt: Create a refined independent travel and slow-living editorial magazine homepage for “Wilderly”. Monumental elegant high-contrast serif logotype and clean magazine navigation. Wide cinematic hero showing a woman seated on a rocky cliff overlooking the sunlit Amalfi Coast; huge poetic serif cover title “Further Still” over the sea on the left, with a narrow right featured-story editorial rail titled “A Quieter Coast”. Below, a restrained four-column magazine grid: lemons and ceramics in a warm farmhouse, mountain hiker, thoughtful maker in her studio, turquoise hidden bay. Subtle hairline rules, off-white paper, tiny tracked uppercase labels, quiet luxurious typography. Photorealistic editorial travel images, precisely spaced desktop full-page design.

items.name: NORD
items.description: 瑞士设计 · 建筑与品牌
items.hero: 超粗标题占左侧模块，建筑摄影占右侧模块，红色几何面形成强记忆锚点。
items.layout: 硬边导航 → 左文案 / 右建筑 / 项目序列 → 介绍栏 + 四列精选项目 → 栅格页脚
items.type: 超粗无衬线大标题、紧凑负字距；导航和图注使用简洁中性字。
items.assets: 建筑外立面、品牌纸品、电脑展示图、袋装物和室外建筑摄影。
items.code: 网格、编号、项目切换、CTA、项目文案、细分隔线都应以 CSS/HTML 实现。
items.reuse: 设计机构、品牌咨询、作品集；适合需要表达秩序、专业与观点的品牌。
items.pitfall: 过量圆角和渐变会毁掉设计语言；项目卡不应被截断。
items.prompt: Art-direct a bold Swiss modernist design studio website called NORD. Restrained black white and vivid signal red palette, asymmetric modular editorial grid, oversized ultra-black grotesk typography reading “IDEAS INTO IMPACT.” on left, minimalist architectural brutalist concrete facade photo with one dramatic red geometric wall on right. Sharp grid lines, compact uppercase navigation, numbered project switcher. Featured projects shown in four strict columns: modern identity print with black typography and red graphic, clean digital product presentation, black fabric campaign bag with large white statement, architectural red-concrete building. No soft gradients, no rounded cards, precise graphic-design portfolio composition, realistic photography, desktop 16:9 visual.

items.name: Pixel Quest
items.description: 像素 RPG · 可玩冒险
items.en: Pixel art / retro RPG landing page
items.hero: 大幅连续像素地图，左侧勇者与狐狸、右侧山峦城堡，中央悬浮关卡标题和开始按钮。
items.layout: 深蓝像素 HUD 导航 → 游戏世界 Hero → 羊皮纸四卡 → 开发日志跑马灯 → 深色页脚
items.type: 像素点阵风格显示字搭配可读性好的等宽正文，描边和硬阴影不可模糊。
items.assets: 像素风景、角色 sprite、城镇和地下城背景可保留像素图。
items.code: HUD 生命金币、开始按钮、交互对话、卡片文字和小游戏画面用 canvas/DOM。
items.reuse: 独立游戏、IP 互动站、游戏活动页；像素缩放使用 image-rendering: pixelated。
items.pitfall: 不要把已画进底图的 START 按钮再覆盖一次；别用平滑插值把像素画弄糊。
items.prompt: Design a richly detailed handcrafted pixel-art retro fantasy RPG game website called PIXEL QUEST. A magnificent panoramic pixel landscape: ancient tree and hanging lantern at left, young red-caped sword hero with a fox on a grassy ledge, turquoise lake, misty blue mountains, distant castle perched on cliffs, waterfall, stone bridge and windmill on the right. At center a big chunky outlined pixel title “PIXEL QUEST” and ornate ruby-red gold-framed START JOURNEY button. Dark navy HUD header with pixel sword logo, coin and red heart counters, highlighted HOME menu. Below the hero, warm parchment panel with four pixel-game scene cards: village, dungeon battle, character roster, enchanted forest. Authentic crisp 16-bit pixel aesthetic, game-ready UI, vibrant light and depth, full website composition.

items.name: Plumhill
items.description: 暖系手绘 · 创意课程
items.hero: 左侧手写式大标题，右侧洒满阳光的手绘工作室，人物、猫、植物和画本形成故事。
items.layout: 手绘字标导航 → 插画场景 Hero → 四列课程卡 → 每日灵感 → 暖色页脚
items.type: 松弛圆润的手写标题，正文保持清晰；用斜体和橘色笔触强调。
items.assets: 手绘人物、猫、植物、画材和课程封面属于插画素材。
items.code: 课程名、讲师、课时、收藏、分类筛选及 CTA 应独立于插画。
items.reuse: 手作课程、生活学习、小众社区、插画品牌；关键是情绪与可亲近感。
items.pitfall: 不要让所有文字都用装饰手写字体；正文必须优先可读性。
items.prompt: Illustrate a charming creative-learning website homepage called Plumhill with a warm hand-painted watercolor and gouache storybook style. A cozy sunlit artist studio overlooking pastel Mediterranean hills, wooden windows, hanging plants, books and paints. Cheerful young illustrator in a burnt-orange knit sweater drawing in a sketchbook, sleepy black-and-white cat beside her, abundance of botanical greens. On the left a very large friendly organic hand-lettered headline “A Kinder Way to Learn and Create”, warm orange paint-stroke button. Four illustrated course thumbnails below: travel sketching by the sea, colorful watercolor palette and flowers, creative journaling notebook, cozy home craft. Cream parchment background, forest-green lettering, cheerful terracotta accents, welcoming sophisticated illustration, cohesive desktop website UI.

items.name: Roamly
items.description: 旅行拼贴 · 纸张手账
items.hero: 剪贴纸张、海岸照片、纸胶带、手写便签和邮票叠压，制造真实手帐层次。
items.layout: 复古旅行字标 → 拼贴封面 → 四栏游记 → 明信片订阅 → 纸张页脚
items.type: 优雅衬线标题 + 手写旁注 + 微型大写分类，视觉层级鲜明。
items.assets: 海岸摄影、手写纸片、旧邮票、植物剪影、撕纸纹理。
items.code: 文章标题、作者、分类标签、订阅输入及链接使用 HTML，胶带可 CSS 绘制。
items.reuse: 旅行博客、咖啡品牌故事、生活方式 DTC、文化手帐；叠层但不能乱。
items.pitfall: 不要把图片上的装饰文字当成正文，放大后会模糊且无法编辑。
items.prompt: Create an art-directed travel-journal collage homepage named “Roamly”. Mediterranean coastal village on dramatic cliffs and turquoise sea forms the central photo, surrounded by torn ivory handmade paper, strips of vintage yellow washi tape, small lemon Polaroid, botanical postage stamp marked ITALIA, subtle postal cancellation marks, pencil doodles and handwritten notes. Large black-green editorial serif title “FAR PLACES, REAL STORIES” printed on layered torn paper at left, mustard-yellow rectangular Explore Stories sticker button. Below, four tidy journal cards with realistic travel photography: quiet Lisbon street with bicycle, Dolomites lake hike, sunlit rustic Italian meal, vintage camper by Adriatic sea. Warm ivory paper texture, authentic analog scrapbooking with elegant editorial discipline.

items.name: Harmonia
items.description: 波普拼贴 · 文化社区
items.hero: 波普人物摄影、几何爆炸图形、粉黄蓝绿块面和黑白棋盘构成强烈拼贴。
items.layout: 紧凑导航 → 大字海报式 Hero + 文化侧栏 → 活动三卡 + 社区招募面板 → 页脚
items.type: 几何超粗标题，正文用中性无衬线；允许大胆压缩行距但不能遮挡脸部。
items.assets: 人物肖像、展览、演出、建筑摄影可使用图像。
items.code: 事件日期、标题、分类、导航列表、社区 CTA 与搜索都用 HTML。
items.reuse: 艺术节、年轻社群、音乐现场、创意文化平台；对比与节奏比精致阴影重要。
items.pitfall: 别让波普元素占满所有可读区域；避免颜色相撞导致按钮文字不可辨。
items.prompt: High-energy maximalist culture platform homepage “HARMONIA”, editorial pop-art design with radical visual confidence. Massive stacked ultra-black heading “A BRIGHTER CULTURE TOGETHER” over electric pink and canary yellow geometric bursts. A stylish young creative person in multicolor patterned fashion photographed against saturated cobalt blue, black-white checkerboard patterns, giant green squiggles, vivid coral panels, halftone shapes and graphic sunburst badges. Right-side pink category navigator with simple black icons. Below: three energetic cultural event cards with colorful glass architecture, neon stage performance, bright abstract museum facade, plus violet community membership poster with acid-yellow starburst. Strict strong typography, punchy visual hierarchy, bold contemporary cultural web design, legible elements.

items.name: Auranova
items.description: 奢华旅行 · 地中海夕阳
items.hero: 整幅地中海日落建筑照片贯穿页面，标题落在左侧相对留白的天空海面上。
items.layout: 轻量透明导航 → 全幅泳池别墅 Hero → 四张目的地摄影卡 → 静奢页脚
items.type: 优雅高对比衬线封面标题，正文衬线偏轻，信息极度克制。
items.assets: 无边泳池、夕阳别墅、海岸风景、沙漠民宿和热带水屋全摄影。
items.code: 目的地标题、地点、圆箭头、收藏与预订表单应独立排版。
items.reuse: 精品酒店、度假民宿、旅行目的地、豪宅展示。
items.pitfall: 避免左右硬切色块削弱一张好摄影的沉浸感；不要塞过多营销组件。
items.prompt: Design a cinematic ultra-premium boutique travel stays website named AURANOVA. Full-bleed breathtaking sunset over the Aegean Sea, contemporary stone villa perched on Mediterranean cliffs, warm interior lights, olive tree and infinite mirror pool flowing toward the ocean in foreground. Editorial classic high-contrast serif headline “Extraordinary Places to Belong” positioned in quiet open sky at left with subtle dark rounded exploration CTA. Very discreet transparent top nav. Beneath hero: four perfectly composed destination photo cards featuring white-blue Santorini architecture, verdant Amalfi Coast, modern desert Joshua Tree retreat, and a luxury overwater Maldives bungalow. Warm rose-gold hour lighting, cinematic photography, quiet luxury, elegant typography, generous clean spacing.

items.name: MotionWay
items.description: 滚动叙事 · 3D 玻璃卡片
items.hero: 左侧大标题 + 右侧 Trigger/Move/Settle 三张倾斜玻璃卡和贯穿的曲线。
items.layout: SaaS 简约导航 → 分段滚动 Hero → 四列功能说明卡 → 产品页脚
items.type: 现代几何无衬线 + 蓝紫渐变重点；模块中的编号与小标题分工明确。
items.assets: 雪山、抽象紫色波纹、悬崖孤树等卡片内部摄影。
items.code: 透视卡片、滚动路径 SVG、阶段进度、导航、按钮和时间线全部由代码制作。
items.reuse: SaaS 产品、交互工具、课程故事页；适合强调流程与变化的产品。
items.pitfall: scroll-driven 固定场景不能困住用户；阶段控件不应与动画主线竞争。
items.prompt: Create a futuristic but friendly scroll-driven animation platform website named MotionWay. Minimal white-to-frost-blue SaaS header with a small purple-blue ribbon logo. Hero left side features huge confident dark navy geometric sans headline “Bring Your Ideas into Motion”, the words “into Motion” in vibrant electric blue-to-violet gradient, concise description and two dark/outlined CTAs. Hero right side shows three staggered tall frosted-glass perspective cards titled Trigger, Move, Settle, featuring a majestic mountain, luminous purple flowing forms, and a lone tree on a cliff. A thin curving blue interaction timeline snakes across the composition with glowing control nodes. Below is a refined four-card product toolkit: timeline editor, scroll triggers, motion presets, publishing integration. Ultra-polished, spacious, futuristic web product design.

items.name: NovaAI
items.description: 深空光环 · 智能工作台
items.zh: 深空极简 AI 品牌
items.hero: 大面积暗夜摄影承托超大冷蓝发光光环，左侧文案轻柔而极简。
items.layout: 深色导航 → 光环 Hero → 四列智能能力卡 → 工作区交互 → 页脚
items.type: 克制中性无衬线、轻量大标题、冷蓝小字；避免金属游戏字体。
items.assets: 发光圆环、深空地表等大背景可保留摄影/生成素材。
items.code: 产品能力图标、API 代码面板、卡片文字、搜索和工作台都是网页组件。
items.reuse: AI 研究产品、云服务品牌、开发者工具；极端深浅对比建立可信感。
items.pitfall: 不要把一张带卡片文字的截图裁成四张，容易产生重复文本与模糊。
items.prompt: Design a premium cinematic artificial-intelligence platform website “NovaAI” on a nearly black night-sky background. Enormous ethereal elliptical ring of cold electric blue light hovering above an alien rocky horizon, the ring looking like a portal with elegant sweeping particles and subtle volumetric light. Left-side minimal typography: “Turn ideas into what’s next.” in large thin clean white sans with the word next tinted pale blue; tiny uppercase label and understated white pill CTA. Quiet top navigation, extremely spacious layout. Below: four dark transparent capability tiles with precise blue holographic visuals, stacked knowledge sheets, generative visual panels, API code-and-cube, collaborative avatars. Deep graphite surfaces, high contrast, delicate hairline blue borders, sophisticated product editorial.
items.original_filename: Dark AI Homepage with Glowing Ring-2.png

items.name: NeonForge
items.description: 霓虹赛博 · 云基础设施
items.zh: 赛博 HUD 云基础设施
items.hero: 未来城市夜景与 HUD 数据叠加，左侧切角面板装载大号机械斜体标题。
items.layout: 霓虹导航 → 赛博城市 Hero + 网络数据 HUD → 四张解决方案卡 → 开发者入口
items.type: 宽体机械无衬线、等宽 HUD 标签；标题斜体配亮青与洋红。
items.assets: 未来城市、机甲人物、无人机、霓虹建筑与场景插画。
items.code: 网络状态、速度指标、项目名、导航、切角边框、部署面板用代码制作。
items.reuse: 游戏云服务、科幻品牌、GPU 产品、XR 平台；强调未来感和运行状态。
items.pitfall: 虚构的延迟数值必须标注演示；高频闪烁与过亮光晕会降低可用性。
items.prompt: A dramatic cyberpunk cloud infrastructure landing page for NEONFORGE. Dense rainy futuristic megacity at dusk, magenta and cyan neon signs, holographic portrait on a giant skyscraper, flying cars, sky bridges, atmospheric fog and silhouetted tech explorer. Black UI frames with precise cyan angular HUD corner cuts and fine circuit lines. Huge aggressive extended italic display headline “POWER NEW WORLDS” glowing cyan through hot pink, left-aligned. Header with geometric cyan-magenta tech logo, outlined nav and vivid magenta Get Started button. Floating network-latency HUD on upper-right. Below four cyberpunk solution cards: AI neural robot portrait, hovering racing craft city, luminous blockchain cube, high-tech server building. Extremely detailed cinematic game-tech visual, disciplined UI layering.

items.name: SparkCrew
items.description: 新粗野主义 · 团队协作
items.hero: 亮黄色底 + 黑色巨型标题；右侧倾斜的白板任务面板与彩色角标构成漫画画面。
items.layout: 漫画式硬边导航 → 双栏大标题 + Kanban 示意 → 四张硬阴影价值卡 → 简洁页脚
items.type: 超粗几何黑体、紧凑大行高，粗黑外框形成强烈品牌辨识度。
items.assets: 漫画光芒、贴纸、装饰星星和插画人物头像可保留图像。
items.code: 看板任务、checkbox、功能卡、标签、CTA 按钮全部构成真 HTML。
items.reuse: 年轻团队 SaaS、创意工具、活动营销、教育协作平台。
items.pitfall: 荧光底色容易造成视觉疲劳；用白色面板隔离复杂信息。
items.prompt: Build a joyful neo-brutalist collaborative workspace SaaS homepage “SparkCrew”. Blazing canary-yellow hero, enormous extra-bold black heading “Good ideas work better together.” with compact line breaks. On right a slightly rotated thick black-outlined kanban product board with cyan frame, white to-do columns highlighted yellow, pink progress column, sky-blue done column, expressive stickers, hot pink explosive stars, playful arrows and comic cursor. Buttons are chunky bright pink and yellow with black offset hard shadows and 3px black borders. Below, four outlined feature cards with cyan, yellow and pink shadows; bold simple icons and accessible text. Unapologetically playful, graphic comic editorial, precise functional web hierarchy.

items.name: Orbitalis
items.description: 复古科幻 · 星球旅行
items.hero: 巨型环绕行星与宇航员成为主视觉，夸张斜体标题呼应 20 世纪太空宣传海报。
items.layout: 复古航天标志导航 → 超宽太空海报 Hero → 行星目的地横条 → 四列任务卡 → 深色页脚
items.type: 宽体斜切机械字 + 小号等宽导航，橘红色局部强调。
items.assets: 宇航员、环形巨行星、火星山脉、星舰和太空基地插画。
items.code: 行星选项、任务票价、按钮、编号、日期、导航与详情交互。
items.reuse: 太空展、科学教育、游戏世界观、未来交通品牌。
items.pitfall: 海报不可代替业务信息结构；行星入口与任务卡片要互相映射。
items.prompt: Design an extraordinary retro-futurist space tourism brand website “ORBITALIS” inspired by 1970s space travel posters and premium mid-century sci-fi illustration. Panoramic alien desert with cream-suited astronaut viewed from behind, monumental orange ringed planet dominating teal starry sky, tiny spacecraft, futuristic domed city and orange rocky mountains. Big slanted condensed heroic headline “THE NEXT HORIZON IS YOURS” in warm bone white and burnt orange at left. Ivory top bar with elegant stylized planet logo and uppercase tracked mission navigation. Under hero a four-stop planet selector Moon, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn; below four cinematic mission travel cards. Warm paper tone, deep space teal, orange-red, analog grain texture, bold screenprint-inflected futuristic graphic aesthetic.

items.name: NOVA
items.description: 液态金属 · 未来时尚
items.hero: 液态银色抽象曲面与未来时尚人物摄影并置，超大镀铬金属立体字。
items.layout: 极简时尚导航 → 人像 + 金属大字 Hero → 四张产品大片 → 极简页脚
items.type: 延伸几何字 / 斜体金属描边大标题，辅以字距拉开的时尚注释。
items.assets: 未来时尚人像、镀铬包、镜面鞋、金属外套和抽象曲面。
items.code: 产品价格、型号、按钮、商品卡、筛选交互必须是真实 HTML。
items.reuse: 未来时装、潮流饰品、概念数码、Y2K 活动页。
items.pitfall: 镀铬效果可以图片/图层辅助，但文字不可只用模糊图片替代；避免过曝。
items.prompt: High-fashion futuristic Y2K chrome editorial ecommerce homepage for “NOVA”. Surreal dreamy pale-blue and pink sky, dramatic fashion portrait of a confident young model wearing liquid chrome futuristic transparent garments, shimmering silver metallic fluid shapes orbiting the model. Huge dimensional reflective chrome headline “FUTURE IS A FEELING” with crisp polished metal reflections. Airy luxury nav, thin black modern type, reflective iridescent pink-silver pill CTA. Lower row features four glossy product photographs: sculptural silver orbit handbag, streamlined futuristic shield sunglasses, metallic sculpted sneakers, iridescent chrome-pink outerwear. High quality fashion campaign photography, subtle starburst symbols, blue-silver-magenta palette, refined editorial interface.

items.name: Pixel Haven
items.description: Windows 95 · 复古网页
items.hero: 灰色系统窗口与立体像素按钮，高对比深蓝标题栏；复古 CRT 电脑插画成为视觉核心。
items.layout: Windows 95 顶部菜单 → 主窗口双栏欢迎页 → 新闻/相册/链接三窗格 → 状态栏页脚
items.type: 经典衬线蓝色大标题 + MS Sans/等宽小字，保持旧系统风味。
items.assets: CRT 桌面场景、相册中的城市与电脑像素摄影。
items.code: 窗口边框、标题栏、最小化/关闭、超链接、访客计数器与导航都可由 CSS/JS 构造。
items.reuse: 怀旧个人主页、数字艺术展、复古交互项目；真实可操作的窗口是价值所在。
items.pitfall: 不要只贴一张 Windows 95 截图；窗口按钮要能响应并具备键盘可用性。
items.prompt: Create a deeply nostalgic authentic 1996 personal homepage “Pixel Haven” in classic Windows 95 visual language. Full grey beveled desktop interface, cobalt-blue window title bars, chunky inset and outset system borders, pixel icons for Home, Journal, About, Gallery, Links and Guestbook, blue underlined hyperlinks and monochrome visitor counter. Hero window left features huge royal blue Times-style headline “Good Computers Build Brighter Days” and welcome paragraph; right is colorful pixel-art night desk with beige CRT monitor showing teal desktop, floppy disks, keyboard, lamp, small green plants and retro computer books. Below three independent classic window panels for latest updates, photo gallery, and site links. Authentic 90s web nostalgia, functional desktop metaphors.

items.name: RawClub
items.description: 粗野主义 · 创意社群
items.hero: 画面几乎只由黑白高压对比与工业摄影构成，块状粗体巨型标题扮演图形。
items.layout: 硬边分格导航 → 左超黑标题 / 右灰度建筑照片 → 四张项目列 → 表格化页脚
items.type: 极窄超黑字、等宽小字、蓝色下划线超链接；基本无圆角。
items.assets: 粗糙水泥建筑、黑白海报、集会现场、印刷字形照片。
items.code: 链接、目录、项目列表、联系表单、页面分割线都使用真实 DOM。
items.reuse: 独立创意社群、实验艺术、开源项目、策展网站。
items.pitfall: 粗野主义不是无序；内部栅格必须比普通站更准确。
items.prompt: Create an uncompromising editorial brutalist creative collective website called RAWCLUB. Architectural black-white split screen, huge compressed ultra-heavy black typography shouting “PEOPLE IDEAS IN PROGRESS.” with near-zero tracking, crisp hard grid lines and pure white background. Right half is high-grain documentary black-and-white photograph of raw concrete megastructure with hand-painted activist statement banner. Black header block logo “RAWCLUB”, numbered and underlined navigation resembling open web links, cobalt blue action button. Four raw monochrome project tiles below featuring urban statement photography, experimental letterform R, offline creative meetup in warehouse, printed makers directory. Pure graphic design brutalism, monospace captions, zero shadows and no rounded cards.

items.name: Flowei
items.description: 自然疗愈 · 生产力工作台
items.zh: 自然生产力 Bento 工作台
items.hero: 左侧大幅山间现代小屋摄影，右边日历与专注计时器组成 Bento 控制台。
items.layout: 简约顶栏 → 大 Hero 卡 / 日程 / 计时器 → 任务清单 + 项目进度 + 小卡 → 温暖页脚
items.type: 温和衬线用于主标题，清晰中性无衬线用于数据和组件。
items.assets: 山地现代住宅、绿植、自然光照片作为情绪视觉。
items.code: 日历、任务列表、计时器、进度条、团队头像、日程信息都应是真组件。
items.reuse: 个人生产力、日历应用、任务 SaaS、企业轻量工作台。
items.pitfall: 仪表盘的卡片很多，更要统一组件 padding 和内容行高；避免文字压在照片阴影上。
items.prompt: Create a calm premium productivity web app dashboard “Flowei” with Nordic biophilic UI. Soft off-white page background, forest-green accents, gentle rounded bento-grid panels and generous breathing room. Main left hero tile uses cinematic natural photography of a modern timber-and-glass retreat above tranquil mountains and misty lake at sunrise, elegant serif headline “Your work, in one peaceful place.” To right a functional monthly calendar, focus countdown circular progress timer and tiny weekly activity chart. Below bento cards: a clear to-do list with checks, project progress bars, small botanical motivational quote photo, ideas list and online team avatars. Editorial typography, muted sage colors, subtle shadows, real product UI structure, balanced desktop layout.

items.name: MindFlow
items.description: 柔和拟态 · 专注计时
items.hero: 极浅蓝灰背景与大号凹凸质感圆环计时器，左侧文字舒缓简洁。
items.layout: 轻量导航 → 左标题/右大计时器 Hero → 四列功能软卡 → 汇总数据面板 → 页脚
items.type: 几何无衬线中等字重、柔和段落；计时器数字要清楚而居中。
items.assets: 植物叶片、陶瓷摆件、背景阴影可用少量视觉素材。
items.code: 圆形进度 SVG、开始暂停、分钟选择、真实计时逻辑、统计卡为可交互 HTML/JS。
items.reuse: 冥想、番茄钟、健康打卡、阅读工具；适合情绪和专注主题。
items.pitfall: 拟态阴影太弱会丧失可访问性；倒计时弧线必须与真实分钟数一致。
items.prompt: Design an ethereal calm focus timer website called MindFlow in soft neumorphism with whisper-blue and light grey palette. Very clean modern SaaS header. Hero left large dark-slate heading “A calmer mind gets more done.” with generous soft typography, subtle blue rounded Start Focusing button. Right a magnificent large circular neumorphic timer with multiple physically plausible inset and raised rings, delicate blue progress arc accurately corresponding to the 25-minute focus session, central 25:00 readout, elevated circular play button and vertically aligned preset duration pills. Gentle sunlit ceramic objects, tiny botanical leaves, subtle natural shadow and minimal white environment. Below four gentle feature cards and a soft statistics strip. Realistic refined accessible UI, uncluttered, smooth subtle gradients.

items.name: Notely
items.description: 复古笔记本 · 皮革纸张
items.hero: 打开的皮革活页手帐作为真实舞台，左右两页分别承载文字与手写拼贴。
items.layout: 深棕皮革导航 → 书本封面 Hero → 纸质四卡功能目录 → 皮革页脚
items.type: 古典高对比衬线 + 自然手写旁注；按钮使用金属蚀刻和压纹。
items.assets: 皮革、牛皮纸、金属扣、照片、干花、指南针等写实物件。
items.code: 书页上的可点击标题、按钮、待办、导航与活动内容由 HTML/JS 实现。
items.reuse: 日记、写作工具、复古品牌、记忆收藏应用；适合沉浸式拟物。
items.pitfall: 装订环必须满足物理遮挡关系：前后环分层，穿过纸张的部分不能露出。
items.prompt: Create a luxurious hyper-real skeuomorphic digital notebook website “Notely” as an open handcrafted leather ring binder viewed directly from above. Rich dark espresso leather cover, embossed stitched borders, two thick tactile cream parchment pages and accurately layered brass binder rings passing through punched holes with physically correct occlusion. Left page has elegant classical serif headline “Notes that feel like yours.” with warm brass engraved CTA. Right page is an exquisitely composed journal collage: vintage mountain Polaroid with translucent tape, pressed dried flowers, handwritten “Small notes. Big changes.”, checklist ideas, small yellow sticky note, pencil sketches, vintage brass compass and fountain pen. Under the book, four paper-textured feature cards with notebook stationery photographs. Warm directional sunlight, gentle shadows, realistic materials, editorial balance.

items.name: Lumora
items.description: 梦幻玻璃 · AI 视觉创作
items.zh: 梦幻玻璃 AI 创作平台
items.hero: 冷暖云海与山脉构成场景，右侧叠放半透明 AI 生成工作台。
items.layout: 淡彩半透明导航 → 左文案右玻璃生成器 Hero → 四张 AI 工具功能卡 → 页脚
items.type: 圆润几何无衬线 + 蓝紫渐变关键词，细节文字使用低饱和深蓝。
items.assets: 粉蓝山海、湖上玻璃建筑、蝴蝶、抽象创意图像作为照片和生图素材。
items.code: 工具栏、输入框、Generate 按钮、预览缩略图、编辑对比滑杆都必须是交互组件。
items.reuse: AIGC 创作平台、设计工具、图像视频产品、创意社区。
items.pitfall: 玻璃卡重叠容易截断内容；重视对比度与屏幕边界，并明确生成是否真实。
items.prompt: Create a dreamy sophisticated AI visual creation studio website “Lumora” with luminous pastel glassmorphism. Horizon-spanning soft lavender, sky blue and peach-pink clouds, epic snowy mountain lake landscape with an elegant modern glass pavilion floating above the water at sunrise. Left huge dark navy rounded sans headline “Turn ideas into extraordinary visuals”, the middle words in violet-to-cyan gradient. Floating translucent creative AI editor pane occupies the right: prompt bar reading “A serene modern house on a lake at sunrise”, violet-blue Generate capsule, slender left tool dock, vivid generated artwork center and three small variant thumbnails at far right. Below four clean translucent toolkit cards showing AI image generation mountain, cinematic ocean wave video, design templates, smart butterfly photo editing split comparison. Precise layered frosted glass, inviting airy modern SaaS UI, premium execution.
